meta.note: Events, deadlines and sign-ups for families. `date` and `end` are calendar days (YYYY-MM-DD); `end` is the last day of a run of days or a sign-up window. `kind` is event, deadline or signup. Past entries stay in the file and fold away at the bottom of the Events tab. Every entry carries `src`, and `rid` links the matching row in resources.json where there is one.
meta.src: Pulled from the v19 workbook, the 6 Nov 2026 Nurse-Family Partnership partner meeting, the 6 Nov 2026 Facebook deep scrape and family weekend guides, and FFA-NC and FEMA notices. Each card names its source.

events.what: Renew NC Single-Family Housing applications closed
events.detail: Repairs, reconstruction and manufactured home replacement across 29 counties. The Helene Resource Center at 94 Coxe Ave (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm) is still the in-person navigation point for recovery programs.
events.src: WNC_Family_Resources_SNIFF_v19_Aug2026.xlsx, ALL RESOURCES tab (Renew NC row)

events.detail: ESA+ runs on its own timeline, so check k12.ncseaa.edu. It needs an eligibility determination from a North Carolina public school from the last three years, which is what the free school evaluation gives a family.
events.src: WNC_Family_Resources_SNIFF_v19_Aug2026.xlsx, ALL RESOURCES tab (Campfire Community School row, added 17 Aug 2026)

events.what: Healthy Blue school supply benefit closed for the year
events.detail: Up to $50 in school supplies for ages 6 to 18, June through September only. Healthy Blue Standard Plan only; children in foster care are usually on Healthy Blue Care Together, a separate plan.
events.src: WNC_Family_Resources_SNIFF_v19_Aug2026.xlsx, ALL RESOURCES tab (Healthy Blue extra benefits row, verified on healthybluenc.com, 4 Aug 2026)

events.what: FEMA Helene housing and rental assistance ended
events.detail: Direct temporary housing and rental assistance for NC Helene survivors both ran through 30 September 2026. Call 211 for current disaster-housing intake.
events.src: FEMA, as recorded on the What changed watch list (data/changelog.json)

events.detail: Run with NCDHHS for kinship caregivers and the professionals supporting relatives with DSS involvement. Lunch provided. Registration was through info@ffa-nc.org.

events.detail: Families register in November, and gifts are given out on 21 and 22 December.
